AC2 (no open profitable position has current_stop below entry_price) is the sprint_backlog.md-flagged staging-only AC for this story -- requires a live-position DB query, not CI-reproducible; the item's own Notes field defers backfill/recompute of existing open positions to after this fix is verified, i.e. a post-merge ops action, not a code-commit deliverable.
